donnees_seedfinder.description_breeder: If you are looking for a flavor filled strain to enjoy this is something you need to try. Grape Agate is a fruit cocktail of terpenes blended into a delicious treat. An exquisite blood orange tangerine with a splash of grape cool aid. Smooth to the lungs and powerful to the tongues. We wanted to make a very powerful terpene rich cultivar that you could smell from a mile away. Purple Candy Cane and Its Mendo Dope intertwined a concoction of oranges, grapes, guava, lemons, berries and candy. This is purely for flavor, very mild high from the smoke but perfect for creativity. Strain Reviews Degus…
